services.name: Children & Teen Belt Tests
services.desc: Join us for an evening of practical self-defense, confidence building, and community connection at our Women’s Self-Defense & Networking Night hosted by Aikido New London County. This is not a fear-based seminar or an intense “fight club” experience - it’s a welcoming, empowering space where women can learn simple, effective skills rooted in awareness, movement, boundaries, and calm under pressure. No experience or athletic background is needed. After training, stay for refreshments, cheese, and networking with other local women in business, leadership, and the community. Come to learn, connect, laugh a little, and leave feeling stronger, more confident, and more supported. Because
